pr_title: Adjust catch playfield and catcher layout to further match osu!(stable)
pr_body: - Closes #18968 This PR is not quite final, but I've spent so much time on this hitting many dead-ends to the point I thought opening a PR and leaving it for someone else to provide a better idea would be wiser (it hurts to give up, but I've never been good at this kind of stuff in the first place). Some of the changes in here may not make any sense, but that's as far as I could go with them. I'll briefly explain each commit in here. ## [Adjust catcher origin position to match 1:1 with stable](https://github.com/ppy/osu/commit/4a36964cd8434ababdd496c2a98d73c12b29e754) In stable, the catcher's origin position is always set to Y = 16, as per the following code: We cannot immediately use that number in `SkinnableCatcher`, because we use dimensions that are technically different from stable (they're same as stable but with stable scale numbers factored in). The factor to convert from stable dimensions to lazer dimensions is basically 0.35x, see [this xmldoc](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/649c447265c30a2f214442ec5b633d12e13821ff/osu.Game.Rulesets.Catch/UI/Catcher.cs#L34) and [stable's definition of `catcherWidth`](https://github.com/peppy/osu-stable-reference/blob/1531237b63392e82c003c712faa028406073aa8f/osu!/GameModes/Play/Rulesets/Fruits/RulesetFruits.cs#L235) for more information. We can simply convert stable's origin position using that factor, resulting in Y = 5.6, dividing by `BASE_SIZE` results in Y = ~0.525 ## [Fix legacy catcher sprites getting shrunk](https://github.com/ppy/osu/commit/22d59b7cd329a0e3284997caea9dd960bbbdf52b) This is a no-brainer, stable doesn't resize any of its sprites, meanwhile lazer is shrinking them down to fit the catcher's catching range boundaries (i.e. `BASE_SIZE`). ## [Adjust catch playfield layout to further match stable](https://github.com/ppy/osu/commit/2d60d4f5a645fd777e01e5abfee32a1e40edee44) This is where things get quite quirky. In stable, the playfield is positioned vertically at essentially 18.75% of the window's height (see [this note](https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/3fdb420f736d569754c9b3105385a116ebc0b5c1/osu.Game.Rulesets.Catch/UI/CatchPlayfieldAdjustmentContainer.cs#L20-L21) and [stable's code](https://github.com/peppy/osu-stable-reference/blob/1531237b63392e82c003c712faa028406073aa8f/osu!/GameField.cs#L73)). This must be done in osu!(lazer) in order for the catcher's positioning to match stable. But it's actually not enough... ...the above is also required for the catcher's position to get as close to stable as possible, and I cannot say anything beyond that I only got that value from eyeballing the catcher between stable and lazer. That offset sounds redundant, but it shows that this whole change is not enough, or that it's misguided for a certain reason. --- I could go ahead and revert all changes other than the one that actually fixes catcher size being different on legacy skins, but I'm not sure how gameplay would sit with catch players once lazer goes ranked, so I thought it's better to focus on matching playfield layout with stable as well.
pr_comments:
@frenzibyte This needs revisiting, not sure if due to https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/24706 being merged or due to the catcher not being limited by that PR, but:

![osu Game Tests 2023-09-26 at 08 32 48](https://github.com/ppy/osu/assets/191335/9d3544ec-594b-4d22-b792-f72759c991f8)
To elaborate on the above: maybe this is "correct" behaviour based on the classic skin's sprite offsets, but needs to be double-checked.

From a quick glance at what's happening, that looks to be indeed "correct" behaviour. In osu!(stable), the origin position of the catcher is set to exactly 16 pixels from the top of the sprite (in 1x version, where catcher is 306x320), regardless of its height or anything else. Also confirmed visually by scaling sprite to 8x its size and checking in gameplay on stable:

I am going to close this PR as I have figured out the source of the discrepancy and want to split the changes such as the playfield layout change becomes a follow-up of all the other changes, in order to help with review.

issue_context.title: osu!catch catcher size does not match stable
issue_context.body:
Without checking the code, I believe this change was made to be more "correct". But if that's the case, it shouldn't be applied to classic skins as it is not what the user has come to expect (and many skins account for this in their textures). ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/18870
Originally posted by **Doxxz** June 27, 2022 ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67333710/175897370-9e92e029-50df-4f33-bc10-37a34a69bed3.png) ![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/67333710/175897507-dcbd4c79-5ea3-43a5-9049-f8079d45fa3d.png) Is this intended?
comments: The issue thread description looks to hint towards a discussion of whether the catcher size should be changed in default/lazer skins as well. But, since it's just a number, I think it's saner to match stable regardless of the skin and call it a day.

> But, since it's just a number, I think it's saner to match stable regardless of the skin and call it a day.

What, why? If lazer's number is in fact "more correct" in some respect (in that it reflects the true catcher range or whatever) then surely this is a chance to _keep_ the thing more correct for new skins, and just revert to the old behaviour in old skins?

Requires investigation as to what the reason for this discrepancy is specifically (if any).
Hmm, right, I wasn't sure what the term "correct" was referring to, but that's a valid point. I'll wait for a response then (cc @peppy).

I think this should be applied in legacy skins for now. Because in newer skins I think we'll want the drawable size to match correctly so we can show the catcher area without hacking in weird paddings.

review_comments: May have something to do with https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/9763. That said I can't find the original offset in stable source so may be a red herring.
Question is, if this is the same thing then which out of `6` and `8` are more correct. I highly doubt it differs per ruleset.
Hmm, you may be onto something. I'll look into this further more, there is something I want to check.
"6" was apparently ballparked. So I'm betting on the fact that one (or both?) values were ballparked.

Turns out the vertical offset that is applied in osu! ruleset is specific to it, stable does not apply any similar adjustment to catch (see [this](https://github.com/peppy/osu-stable-reference/blob/3ea48705eb67172c430371dcfc8a16a002ed0d3d/osu!/GameField.cs#L64)).
Surely this can be avoided by adjusting the visual elements to use centre origin...
I didn't look too much, you might have better clues on how this one can be adjusted than I do.
Where are these factors in stable code?
I have opened this PR before we seemed to have allowed referencing osu!(stable) code over the codebase (in a recently merged PR that I have forgot its name), so I did not reference by line.
